'''Jogi''' is an [[Indo-Aryan language]] spoken by at least some of the caste of [[Jogi (caste)|Jogis]] of India and [[Pakistan]]. The language is generally considered a dialect of [[Marwari language|Marwari]], but the pronouns are distinct. Many [[Hindu]] as well as [[Muslim]] [[Jogi (caste)|Jogi's of Sindh]] speak Jogi language as their native including [[Sindhi language|Sindhi]] as well; whereas Jogi in other parts of Pakistan speak mostly Jogi language.<ref>{{cite web|title=A language of Pakistan|url=https://www.ethnologue.com/language/jog|website=[[ethnologue]]|accessdate=7 May 2016}}</ref> However, the Jogi living in [[Thari Mirwah]] Sindh are a sub-caste of the Rajpar tribe, whose native language is [[Sindhi language|Sindhi]], and do not speak Jogi.
